title: MediBook Patient Feedback
instructions: Please share your experience with our clinic by answering the five questions below.
questions: How would you describe your overall experience with our clinic?
What did you think about the appointment booking process?
How satisfied were you with the care provided by your doctor?
What challenges did you experience during your visit?
What improvements would you recommend for our services?
answers: My overall experience was positive. The staff were welcoming, and the clinic was well organized.
The appointment booking process was simple and convenient. I was able to select a doctor and book an available time slot easily.
I was very satisfied with the care provided by my doctor. The doctor listened carefully, explained my condition, and answered my questions.
I experienced a short waiting time before seeing the doctor, but the overall visit went smoothly.
I recommend improving waiting-time management and providing regular appointment reminders to patients.
